paragraphs:
Hi, I’m Loukia, a film director
and photographer in Berlin.

I grew up between Cyprus and Georgia
and have been taking pictures since I was a child.
For the last five years or so, I’ve been directing.

I’m often drawn to faces
you haven’t seen on screen before.

What I care about is people
feeling at ease in front of the camera,
images that feel honest rather than staged,
and diversity, in front of the camera and behind it.

My short films have been shown at festivals
and won a few awards.

I’m also co-founder and creative director
of undercurrent films, a production studio in Berlin,
so I can take on projects of any size,
from small shoots to productions across several countries.
